mentions.name: OneBusAway Cloud
mentions.description: A cloud platform for public transit, described as 'Heroku for public transit'. It is a project of the nonprofit Open Transit Software Foundation and is used to fund the foundation's other initiatives, such as bringing realtime transit information to billions of people around the world.
